## Series
- [3D Concept Visualizations](../series/concept-viz/SERIES.md) (`concept-viz`, active, 1 video): Complex technical systems explained as physical, spatial machines you can see working.
- [Festival & Celebration](../series/festivals/SERIES.md) (`festivals`, active, 1 video): Visual pieces for traditional and seasonal celebrations, built on workflows that return every year.
- [Micro Films](../series/micro-films/SERIES.md) (`micro-films`, active, 0 videos): Short conceptual and philosophical films about consciousness, humanity, AI and the future.
- [Product & Launch](../series/product-launch/SERIES.md) (`product-launch`, active, 0 videos): Polished code-generated motion graphics: product demos, launch films and UI animation.
- [Science & Knowledge Explainers](../series/science-explainers/SERIES.md) (`science-explainers`, active, 0 videos): Dense, honest explanations of hard ideas in mathematics and physics, from open problems to prize-winning work.

## Engines and templates
- [Remotion engine (`@aiv/engine-remotion`)](../engines/remotion/ENGINE.md) (`remotion`) · template [templates/remotion](../templates/remotion/README.md): The Remotion engine renders a React/Remotion composition, frame by frame and deterministically, into the shared chunk runner.
- [Web engine (`@aiv/engine-web`)](../engines/web/ENGINE.md) (`web`) · template [templates/web](../templates/web/README.md): The web engine captures any page that installs the page contract, frame by frame and deterministically, into the shared chunk runner.
- [Stage documents](../templates/_video/): the stubs `aiv new` copies into every video (BRIEF.md, CREDITS.md, FACTS.md, README.md, SCRIPT.md, STORYBOARD.md, TREATMENT.md)

## Packages
- `@aiv/core` ([packages/core](../packages/core)): Isomorphic determinism helpers (seeded rng, easing, test swatches) and the shared zod contracts.
- `@aiv/pipeline` ([packages/pipeline](../packages/pipeline)): Node pipeline stages shared by every engine: host safety, ffmpeg/encode presets, chunk runner, QA and release.
- `@aiv/remotion-kit` ([packages/remotion-kit](../packages/remotion-kit)): Deterministic React/Remotion building blocks: a Stage3D for R3F under Remotion, titles, test swatches.
- `@aiv/engine-remotion` ([engines/remotion](../engines/remotion)): Remotion engine adapter: bundles a video's Remotion entry and renders compositions to a mezzanine plus render.json.
- `@aiv/engine-web` ([engines/web](../engines/web)): Web engine: Playwright harness that captures page-contract pages (canvas, WebGL, WebGPU, SVG) deterministically, plus the in-page runtime.
- `@aiv/cli` ([tools/aiv](../tools/aiv)): The aiv command line: new, doctor, check, render, audio, post, qa, release, heavy.

## Knowledge
- [Convert RGB frames to BT.709 once, explicitly, and check it from the final file](../knowledge/bt709-from-rgb.md): Rendered frames are sRGB-encoded RGB. Video delivery is YUV with a colour matrix and a range.
- [Plan a camera move by how fast its picture moves, before rendering it](../knowledge/camera-moves-by-screen-flow.md): A camera path that looks fine as positions and angles can still strobe at 24 fps without motion blur, or wipe a near object across the lens: what the eye sees is how many pixels…
- [Make every frame a pure function of its index](../knowledge/deterministic-frames.md): A video rendered in chunks, resumed after a crash, or re-rendered next month must produce the same pixels for the same frame.
- [Capture WebGL and WebGPU on a Windows laptop GPU with headless Chrome](../knowledge/headless-gpu-windows.md): Headless Chrome can render on the real GPU of a modest Windows laptop, but only with the right build and flags, and its screenshots are the wrong way to get frames out.
- [Master to -14 LUFS with a two-pass, linear loudnorm](../knowledge/loudness-two-pass.md): Platforms turn loud uploads down and leave quiet ones quiet, so a mix should arrive at the platform's reference loudness with headroom for true peaks.
- [Animate everything on ones when the camera moves, and measure cadence, not stills](../knowledge/motion-cadence.md): A stylised film often animates its characters "on twos" (a new pose every other frame) for a hand-made feel.
- [A painted moonlit night in real-time 3D comes from the darks, the depth and the sky, not from the models](../knowledge/painterly-night-3d.md): Real-time 3D lit by a moon behind the scene renders as black cut-outs with a cyan outline: every face toward the camera is in shadow, and shadows in a physically based renderer…
- [Render React Three Fiber under Remotion so every chunk start looks the same](../knowledge/r3f-under-remotion.md): Remotion renders a 3D scene one frame at a time, in chunks, and each chunk usually starts on a fresh page.

## Agent skills and agents (Claude Code)
- [skill `make-video`](../.claude/skills/make-video/SKILL.md): Start or continue a video in this repository, from idea to release (new slot, brief, treatment, script, storyboard, facts, scene code, review cut, final, release). Use for any work under videos/<slug>/ or when the user wants a new video. Routes to the aiv commands and docs/PRODUCTION.md, keeps the lifecycle gates and stops at the user's approval points.
- [skill `render-verify`](../.claude/skills/render-verify/SKILL.md): Render, encode and verify a video or template, and actually look at the result (aiv render, post, qa, contact sheet, motion QA, frame crops, lookdev stills against a reference, determinism and resume checks). Use after changing scene or shared rendering code, before saying a render works, and before any review cut or release.
- [agent `frame-critic`](../.claude/agents/frame-critic.md): Adversarial visual reviewer for renders and lookdev stills. Give it a target (video slug or template:<engine>) and a profile, or a stills folder, and optionally reference images; it inspects the contact sheet, extracted frames, motion QA and stills, and judges them against the brief, storyboard, series guide, style and references, returning pass/partial/fail per criterion with evidence. Read-only by instruction (its Bash is for ffmpeg frame extraction into a temporary folder).
